definitions.explanation: An urban area; a populated place.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{町|まち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{町|まち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{町|まち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しました→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved to a new town.
There are two stations in this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧{町|まち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧でした。
examples.english: The town where I was born was near the mountains, and the air was very clean.

notes:
{町|まち} refers to a town or urban area, often used for smaller municipalities or neighborhoods.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {町|まち}: town, municipality (administrative unit)
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧: city streets, downtown area (emphasis on the urban atmosphere)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {町|まち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go into town
- {町|まち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shop in town
- {町|まち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk around town
- ⟦{町|まち}{並|な}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧: townscape, row of houses

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧: village (smaller than {町|まち})
- ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧: city (larger than {町|まち})
- ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧: urban area, city
